description: From the plaza, the Church of San Juan Bautista rises over Arucas — its great neo-Gothic facade of blue Arucas stone floodlit against the night, twin spires climbing into the dark. The quiet plaza spreads at its feet with the town's lights beyond, and the church's carved stonework glows in the lamps. They call it the cathedral of the north; by night it dominates its town like a stone ship.
